name: Seeded defects for the Day 4 judge (testgen benchmark)

change_history.change: For judge v2: atomic expectations (SD10 control, SD15 bundled case); concrete counts only inputs that matter (SD16); technique without an explicit value is not boundary (SD17); recall implied outcome (RS08), background assumptions (RS09), range covers member (RS10), and a control that the looser rules still reject a non-boundary case for a boundary idea (RS11).
First version: 15 case seeds (Call A) and 7 recall seeds (Call B), including controls that should pass.

notes: Hand-made cases with a known correct judge verdict. Run with: python -m bench.score --seeded
Controls (defect starts with 'control') are correct cases: they catch a judge that fails everything.
Expected values for case seeds: verdict, technique, concrete, atomic, unsupported (AC IDs the judge should not find supported), duplicate_of.
Recall seeds use real expected ideas from testgen_golden.json v1.0 and test decisions D1 to D3 and the boundary rule.

seeds.defect: off-by-one: deadline day treated as late

case.title: Claim on the deadline day
preconditions: Treatment date 10 March 2027.
Submission date 10 March 2028.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code LATE_SUBMISSION.

case.title: Leap-day treatment submitted on 28 February
preconditions: Treatment date 29 February 2028.
Submission date 28 February 2029.
case.expected_result: The claim is on time and is not routed with LATE_SUBMISSION.

seeds.defect: control: other side of the same boundary is not a duplicate

case.title: Leap-day treatment submitted on 1 March
preconditions: Treatment date 29 February 2028.
Submission date 1 March 2029.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code LATE_SUBMISSION.

seeds.defect: at-limit amount treated as over the limit

case.title: GP visit at 60
preconditions: GP visit claim for 60.00.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code OVER_LIMIT.

seeds.defect: 'greater than the limit' with no value is not a boundary test

case.title: Consultant visit above its limit
preconditions: A consultant visit claim for an amount greater than 120.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code OVER_LIMIT.

seeds.defect: wrong precedence: HIGH_VALUE instead of OVER_LIMIT

case.title: GP visit for 1,000.01
preconditions: GP visit claim for 1,000.01; the GP visit limit is 60.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code HIGH_VALUE.

seeds.defect: accident accepted from the claimant's note alone

case.title: Accident stated by the member
preconditions: Physiotherapy on day 60 of the policy.
Provider description: 'physiotherapy session, lower back'.
Claimant note: 'this was from a car accident'.
case.expected_result: The accident exemption applies and the claim is not routed with WAITING_PERIOD or UNCLEAR.

seeds.defect: over-claims AC4, which the case does not test

case.title: Consultant visit with no referral
preconditions: Consultant visit claim with no referral attached.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code MISSING_REFERRAL.

seeds.defect: several claim types bundled in one case (not atomic)

case.title: Claim types that need no referral
preconditions: A GP visit claim with no referral.
A prescription claim with no referral.
A day case procedure claim with no referral.
steps: Triage each of the three claims.
case.expected_result: None of the three claims is routed with MISSING_REFERRAL.

seeds.defect: asserts a response time the story never states

case.title: Appeal answered within 10 working days
preconditions: A member has appealed a declined claim through the member portal.
case.expected_result: A senior claims assessor not involved in the original decision responds within 10 working days.

seeds.defect: asserts a confirmation email the story never mentions

case.title: Claim with itemised receipt is confirmed by email
preconditions: Member portal claim with an itemised receipt showing treatment, date and amount.
case.expected_result: The member receives a confirmation email within one hour.

case.title: Decline an excluded treatment
preconditions: A claim is submitted for an excluded treatment.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code EXCLUDED.

seeds.defect: missing input should be classed negative, whatever the case calls itself

case.title: Inpatient claim with blank pre-authorisation
preconditions: Inpatient stay of two nights.
Pre-authorisation number is blank.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code MISSING_PREAUTH.

seeds.defect: control: concrete enough, because the procedure type does not matter to the rule tested

case.title: Day case with blank pre-authorisation
preconditions: Hospital treatment with no overnight stay.
Pre-authorisation number is blank.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to manual_review with reason code MISSING_PREAUTH.

case.title: Ninth GP visit in the policy year
preconditions: 8 GP visits already paid this policy year.
steps: Triage a new GP visit claim.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code ANNUAL_LIMIT_REACHED.

case.title: GP claim after the annual allowance is used up
preconditions: The member has had all 8 GP visits paid in the current policy year.
steps: Submit one more GP visit claim and triage it.
case.expected_result: Decline is recommended: decline_recommended, reason ANNUAL_LIMIT_REACHED.

seeds.defect: control: same wording pattern, different category, not a duplicate

case.title: Fifth consultant visit in the policy year
preconditions: 4 consultant visits already paid this policy year.
steps: Triage a new consultant visit claim.
case.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code ANNUAL_LIMIT_REACHED.

cases.title: Treatment after the waiting period
preconditions: Consultant visit after the waiting period has ended.
cases.expected_result: The claim is not routed with WAITING_PERIOD.

cases.title: Accident exemption shown by the provider
preconditions: Physiotherapy on day 10 of the policy.
Provider description: 'physiotherapy session for an ankle sprain from a fall'.
GP referral attached.
cases.expected_result: The claim is not routed with WAITING_PERIOD.

expect.defect: boundary idea (day 182) against a case with no explicit day
control: equivalent value (day 10 for day 0), same condition and outcome (D1)

cases.title: Treatment outside Ireland
preconditions: A claim for treatment received outside Ireland.
cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code EXCLUDED.

cases.title: Alternative therapy
preconditions: A claim for an alternative therapy, such as acupuncture or homeopathy.
cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code EXCLUDED.

expect.defect: misses the distinguishing detail: a covered category (GP visit) received abroad (D3)
control: class with example covers a member of the class (D2)

cases.title: Leap-day treatment on time
preconditions: Treatment date 29 February 2024.
Submission date 28 February 2025.

cases.title: Late claim
preconditions: The claim is submitted more than 12 months after the treatment date.
cases.expected_result: The claim is routed to decline_recommended with reason code LATE_SUBMISSION.

expect.defect: control: equivalent year, same rule and outcome (D1)
boundary idea (one day late) against 'more than 12 months' with no date

cases.title: Day case just over 1,000
preconditions: Day case procedure claim for 1,000.01 with a pre-authorisation number.
cases.expected_result: The claim is not high value and is not routed with HIGH_VALUE.

cases.title: Physiotherapy with a GP referral
preconditions: A physiotherapy claim with a referral from a GP attached.
cases.expected_result: The attached referral meets the referral requirement for physiotherapy.

expect.defect: control: 'meets the referral requirement' implies not MISSING_REFERRAL (implied outcome)

cases.title: Second day case in the year
preconditions: One day case procedure already paid this policy year.
steps: Submit a day case procedure claim.
cases.expected_result: The annual limit does not stop the claim.

cases.title: Paid count is per policy year
preconditions: A later policy year has started.
The category had paid claims in the previous policy year.
steps: Submit a claim in that category during the later policy year.
cases.expected_result: The annual limit does not stop the claim when the count for this policy year is below the limit.

expect.defect: control: background assumptions ('all other details correct') need not be restated
boundary idea (claim on the anniversary after 8 GP visits) against a case with no anniversary date, category or count

cases.title: Accident shown by the provider in the waiting period
preconditions: Treatment date before day 182.
The provider's treatment description shows the injury was accidental.
cases.expected_result: The waiting-period exemption applies; the claim is not routed with WAITING_PERIOD.

expect.defect: control: a range ('before day 182') covers a member (day 0) for a non-boundary idea
